newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria M1 rises 9 pct, M2 up 10 pct Feb 7-14.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria M1 rises 9 pct, M2 up 10 pct Feb 7-14.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 329.8 billion levs ($191.7 million) on February 14 from 302.7 billion levs on February 7, and M2 increased to 4,287.3 billion levs from 3,884.7 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.

Total broad money rose 10.38 percent to 4,643.3 billion levs in the week to February 14 as lev-denominated broad money inched up 3.33 percent to 753 billion levs and dollar-denominated broad money increased 11.85 percent to 3,890.3 billion levs.
Companies' hard currency-denominated deposits totalled $745.4 million on February 14, up from $739 million a week earlier.
But individuals' foreign currency-denominated deposits fell $13.7 million to $460.4 million in the week ending February 14, figures showed.

Lev-denominated deposits of individuals edged down to 74.6 billion levs on February 14 from 75.7 billion levs on February 7. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569 ($ = 1720 Bulgarian Levs)
